{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA test orders: revenue = 999999.99
df_qa = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA test orders:", len(df_qa))
print("Sample of QA orders:")
print(df_qa[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue', 'converted']].head())"}
